prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated living Glebionis coronaria edible crown daisy / shungiku / 茼蒿 plant, medium narrow deeply lobed leaf type, as image-to-3D reference for a Jiangnan miniature farm. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY, approved Chinese gongbi light-colour painting: fresh muted sage/jade greens, layered watercolor pigment mottling, deliberate fine moss-green contours and structural midrib lines. Do not copy bok choy anatomy, white thick stems or inflated leaves. Other images are botanical shape references only. A convincing volumetric plant with ROUND slender green stems and THIN softly cupped leaves facing varied directions; camera elevated 35 degrees downward in three-quarter view, clear front/back overlap and depth, not a flat herbarium fan. Plain uniform neutral light-gray background. Full silhouette with generous margins. Matte diffuse even light; no cast shadow, no pots, soil, loose balls, base disk, roots, flowers, text or other objects. All stems connected to ONE short basal planting anchor, all leaves visibly above anchor. Preserve clear delicate ink-and-wash brushwork, not glossy photorealism or neon green. Harvest-ready vegetative plant BEFORE flowering: ONE upright tender green stem, three short natural leafy side branches, about FOURTEEN elongated deeply lobed true leaves in an airy rounded crown, leaf attachment points distributed along the stem. Main stem visible in lower third and between leaves, not a bunch of separate harvested stems tied together. Leaves alternate; each elongated blade has 4-5 pairs of narrow rounded/triangular lobes attached to a continuous central midrib blade, not isolated parsley leaflets or needle-like dill. Upper leaves smaller, lower leaves arch outward, no leaves hanging below planting anchor. Height about 1.2 times spread, full round volume and clear foreground, side and receding leaves. No buds, daisies or bolting stem. Limit tiny noisy detail while maintaining distinctive deeply lobed crown-daisy silhouette.
revision_prompt: Edit this crown daisy reference, keep its species, exact lobed leaf anatomy, fine ink contour/vein marks and watercolor mottled sage-green texture. Transform only the plant's spatial pose and viewpoint into an unmistakably THREE-DIMENSIONAL living plant. View DOWN from 45 degrees above at a three-quarter angle. Leaves spiral around the round stem in ALL directions: foreground leaves foreshortened toward viewer, two side leaves almost edge-on, several back leaves receding with overlap. Do NOT show all leaf faces frontally. Stems cylindrical, leaf surfaces thin gently cupped and bent, visible depth about equal to width. Roots hidden: show one short planting anchor below ALL leaf tips, no leaves pointing below the root base. No soil, pot, pedestal, loose particles, flowers, text or cast shadow. Uniform light-gray background. Preserve the handmade painted texture while using clear diffuse 3D shading; no glossy rubber surfaces. Keep one main stem and three short leafy side branches, compact harvest-ready tuft with about 16 main leaves, no flowering or additional foliage.
